name: World Title
epitaph: The XWF's top championship, named on all four of the fed's own title pages and held by nobody. The fed's own current-champions page records the belt VACANT with no number-one contender, and its title-histories page carries the heading PREVIOUS HOLDERS with nothing under it: no reign of this championship survives, and the record does not show one ever being decided.
notes: Receipts: promotions/xwf-2001/archive/current-champions.html (the served current-champions page) and the fed's own unserved rankings and title-histories pages. "World Title" is the fed's own rankings/histories styling; its champions page styles the holder "World Champion."

name: TV Title
epitaph: The XWF's television championship, and the one belt its surviving card was actually going to decide: the Monday Night Massacre battle royal promised to crown the Television Champion, and no result of it survives. The fed's own current-champions page records the belt VACANT with no number-one contender, and its title-histories page carries the heading PREVIOUS HOLDERS with nothing under it: no reign of this championship survives, and the record does not show one ever being decided.
notes: Receipts: promotions/xwf-2001/archive/current-champions.html and promotions/xwf-2001/archive/monday-night-massacre-card.html; also named on the fed's own unserved rankings and title-histories pages.
